source.title: Banbridge Chronicle, 31 May 1902, p. 3 ("Local Government Elections": Armagh County Council); nominations and labels also in the Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1902, p. 2 ("But Few Contests": county council nominations, with labels)
source.publisher: Banbridge Chronicle (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every figure read from the page image (the Armagh Guardian, 30 May 1902, p. 4, prints the same contests but its page scan is cut off before the figures)

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1902: polled 28 May 1902 in six divisions; the other fifteen divisions (seventeen seats) were returned unopposed. Thompson, the retiring member, is labelled P.H.R. (Protestant Home Ruler) by the Banbridge Chronicle and the Irish News (28 April 1902, p. 7) and U. by the Armagh Guardian nominations list; no party code assigned.
